---
name: execute-task
description: Triage and complete a development or data-analysis task with the appropriate specialist workflow and quality gate.
agent: task-coordinator
---

Receive the requested task and drive it to a verified handoff.

Discover repository context first, classify the task, select the applicable specialist rules, and define measurable acceptance criteria. Implement the smallest coherent solution, update tests and documentation, run repository-supported checks, and perform a final quality review.

For data analysis, preserve reproducible queries or code and cite the computed evidence. For development, preserve public contracts unless a breaking change is explicitly approved.
